about: One community, several addresses, slice S0 (scratch/fable-design/DESIGN-several-addresses-fable.md §2.2, §2.3): the signed address list, the proof, the one spelling of an address and the (epoch, seq) order, frozen.

Read by @beanpool/core's tests now (src/__tests__/address-list-vectors.test.ts, address-list-table.test.ts), and by the server's and the phone's when their slices land, so every runtime is held to the SAME bytes and the SAME choices.

Made once (2026-11-16) by a throwaway script that built every signed text from the design's words with @noble/curves directly, not with address-list.ts. Never regenerate it to make a client pass: a client that disagrees has changed the protocol every phone checks.

keys: two Ed25519 test seeds (bytes 1..32 and 33..64) and their libp2p PeerIds. lists: signed documents by name; text is the signed text (the bytes are 0xFF then its UTF-8) where pinned. table: kept (a list name or null) x offered -> keep / replace / refuse, with the reason. proofs: a question and an answer -> its verdict. questions: what a server holding the list "kept" answers (null = signs, 400, 421).
